fusions.name: Strip the Stores
fusions.desc: Looses 4 rats at once, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Picked Bare
fusions.desc: Darts at one enemy up to 5 tiles away that is at or below 30% health and deals 20 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, healing you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Granary Cloud
fusions.desc: Takes 0.5 seconds to loose a cloud of rats and locusts for 12 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 4 health.

fusions.name: Fat Years
fusions.desc: Every time you kill an enemy, a stack builds on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
